about: Women's football shorts (new "Women's football shorts" tile in Football right after Women's football jersey; coordinator 23 Nov, cards 67909 front / 67787 back): Tripo model women-football-shorts-textured.glb (shape only) in the cards' shorts colours: royal blue all over, its own elastic waistband the same blue (the Waistband part); our 3 mark low on the front left leg where the card has its mark, our wordmark beside it small (the card has no other text on the shorts).
